_comment: Custom playable classes. One entry here generates everything the client and the world database need:
ChrClasses, the race/class pairs, skills, starting outfit, the world tables and the client class table.
Spells, talents and icons are authored separately (see localTools/patchSinisterStrike.ps1).
id            ChrClasses id: 10, or 12-15 (1-9 and 11 are Blizzard's). A slot left out here is wiped.
token         Client class token, uppercase ASCII, used for icons, colors and class texts.
templateClass Existing class whose combat formulas, skills and base stats are reused.
startClass    Class whose starting gear is copied (default: templateClass).
startOutfit   Item ids a new character starts with, equipped where possible. Each replaces the copied
start gear of its slot (a two-hander replaces the sword): gear for a class starting above 1.
previewOutfit Item ids used only to dress the character-creation model. The generated outfit keeps the
start class's real item ids, so preview armor is never granted to a new character.
stockPreviewOutfits (top level) The same for the stock classes: class id -> item ids, dressing every race
and gender of that class on the creation screen (keys starting with _ are comments).
An entry may be [item id, inventory type] to show an item in another slot (21 main hand).
startLike     { race, class }: every race starts exactly where that race and class do.
classSkill    { id, name, icon }: the class's own skill line, which is its spellbook tab, and the
carries the template's tabs (a Pestiféré would have Blood, Frost and Unholy).
talentTabs    The class's own talent trees, instead of sharing the template's: exactly three. The client's
inspect code keeps one slot per tree and every stock class has three; inspecting a class
with another count after a stock one resizes those slots and corrupts them (Wow.exe crash
0x5C681E), so a class with fewer real trees declares empty ones to make three. Without
them the class is added to the template's TalentTab rows, which is how a Pestiféré ended
up showing Blood, Frost and Unholy. Each tree:
id          TalentTab.dbc id, unused (Blizzard's stop at 411).
name        Tab name shown above the tree.
background  The client loads Interface\TalentFrame\<background>-{Top,Bottom}{Left,Right}.blp,
so it must match the art shipped by localTools/mpq-builder/patchFiles.js.
icon        SpellIcon.dbc icon file name for the tab button.
tabPage     0-2, the tree's slot in the talent frame.
talents     The grid: { id (Talent.dbc id), name, tier (row, 0-based), column (0-3),
ranks (one spell id per rank, authored in patchSinisterStrike.ps1),
requires { talent: <name>, rank } }. A prerequisite is drawn by the client
as a straight line, so keep it in the same column with nothing in between.
talentTree    Path of a retail-style talent tree (class tree + spec tree) replacing the WotLK talents: the
class then gets no stock talent points, and its talentTabs stay empty (the client still needs
three). Built by localTools/talentTree/buildTalentTree.py; see localTools/oathblade/talentTree.json.
inheritSpells true (default): the class also starts with the template's abilities and uses its trainers.
false: only the spells listed in startSpells, for a class with an authored kit.
startSpells   Spells a new character knows: proficiencies and its own abilities.
powerType     0 mana, 1 rage, 3 energy (runes are Death Knight only in the client).
spellFamily   Spell family of the class's own spells (default 0). The client applies talent modifiers
only to spells of the class's family, so it must match the family its spells carry.
roles         Dungeon Finder roles it may queue as: any of tank, healer, damage (default: damage).
races         ChrRaces ids allowed to pick it (1 Human, 2 Orc, 3 Dwarf, 4 Night Elf, 5 Undead, 6 Tauren,
7 Gnome, 8 Troll, 10 Blood Elf, 11 Draenei).
startLevel    Level a new character starts at (default: the realm's start level). The server raises a new
character to it; the realm's start level wins if it is higher.
iconCell      Cell [column, row] in the 4x4 class icon sheet the creation screen uses.
classIcon     The class's own icon art (square, any size), used wherever a class icon is drawn.
detailsCell   Free cell [column, row] of Details' class icon sheet: [2, 2] or [3, 2].
color         Class color as [r, g, b] 0-1, for unit frames and chat.
